coverage_notes:
SOURCES USED (in order of authority for this roster):
1. Archived rolltide.com athletics staff directory, Jan. 9, 2013 capture (two days after the BCS title game): https://web.archive.org/web/20130109065314/http://www.rolltide.com/staffdir/alab-staffdir.html — has a "Football" department block plus Strength and Conditioning, Training, Video Services, Equipment and Communications blocks. Best HTML source: most rows are plain text in a <td> ("Name, Title"), so quotes are contiguous in the raw HTML.
2. 2012 Alabama BCS National Championship bowl guide PDF (published for the Jan. 7, 2013 game): https://web.archive.org/web/20140425043403/http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/alab/sports/m-footbl/auto_pdf/2012-13/misc_non_event/2012-bcs-bowl-guide.pdf — coaching staff directory on guide page 2, coach bios pages 40-51, "Support Staff" bios pages 52-55 and a 35-person support-staff photo grid on guide page 56 (PDF page 58). This is the authoritative "who was on staff at the championship game" list.
3. 2012 Alabama Football Media Guide PDF (dated Aug. 20, 2012): https://web.archive.org/web/20130430194155/http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/alab/sports/m-footbl/auto_pdf/2012-13/misc_non_event/20120820football-guide.pdf — same support-staff grid on guide page 92 (PDF page 94), used to detect in-season title changes.
4. Archived 2012 Alabama Football Roster page (Coaches block), Nov. 16, 2012: https://web.archive.org/web/20121116154713/http://www.rolltide.com/sports/m-footbl/mtt/alab-m-footbl-mtt.html?DB_OEM_ID=27300
5. Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012_Alabama_Crimson_Tide_football_team

QUOTE CAVEATS — please read before machine-matching:
- All non-empty quotes were verified programmatically against freshly downloaded copies of the exact URLs cited. Every staff-directory quote marked as such is a contiguous substring of the raw HTML except where noted.
- For the ten on-field assistant coaches and for Saban, Cochran, Pannunzio and Gonnella, the staff directory wraps the person's name in an <a> tag, so "Name, Title" is contiguous only in the RENDERED page text, not in the raw HTML. Same for the roster page, where the rendered form is "Name - Title". Strip tags without inserting separators and the quotes match.
- Wikipedia's coaching-staff table puts name and role in separate cells, so for those people the Wikipedia quote is the role cell alone; the person is identified in the source note.
- All PDF-sourced rows use quote:"" per instructions. Two reasons: (a) the support-staff page is a photo grid where each person's first name, LAST NAME and title are separately positioned text runs, so no contiguous "name + title" string exists in the text layer; I reconstructed the pairings by clustering the text runs by x-coordinate column, which is reliable and I verified it against known-good facts; (b) the guides' body text has systematic ligature/spacing corruption in the extracted text layer ("Th e", "fi eld", "off ense"), so nothing can be copied faithfully.

WHAT I COULD NOT DOCUMENT:
- George Helow (defensive analyst) and John Van Dam (graduate assistant) appear ONLY on Wikipedia's uncited analyst/GA lists. I searched the August 2012 media guide, the January 2013 BCS bowl guide, the April 2013 spring guide, and the September 2012 and January 2013 athletics staff directories, and neither name appears in any of them. They are included with an explicit unverified flag; consider dropping them if the dataset requires corroborated sources.
- Larry Waters (assistant equipment manager) appears only in the January 2013 BCS bowl guide grid, in the slot the August guide assigned to Jeremy "Bear" Jordan. I could not find a hire announcement or any second source, so I cannot say whether Jordan moved roles or left. Both are included with midseason notes.
- Four support-staff titles differ between the August 2012 media guide and the January 2013 bowl guide (Sigler, Neighbors, Montinar, and Wright's singular/plural). I used the January (championship-time) wording and flagged the change in midseason_note.
- Alabama's Strength and Conditioning department listed eleven staff in the athletics directory, but only Cochran, Terry Jones, Mark Hocke and Kindal Moorehead appear on the football support-staff grid. I excluded the other seven (Rocky Colburn, Michelle Martin Diltz, Jonathan Farris, Jim Hamner, Corey Harris, Travis Illian, Andy Weigel) because the program's own publications do not assign them to football. Same reasoning excluded the athletics-wide athletic trainers assigned to other sports.
- Student assistants, undergraduate managers and student trainers below the media-guide grid are not documented anywhere I could find; the true headcount around the program was certainly larger than 57.
- No graduate-assistant hire announcements or a dedicated "football support staff" web page existed on rolltide.com in this era; the athletics staff directory omits analysts' specific offensive/defensive designations (it lists all seven directory-listed analysts generically as "Football Analyst") and omits the GAs, student assistants, state troopers, FCA director and academic advisor entirely — those come only from the PDF guides.
- WebSearch was unavailable for this session (budget exhausted), so I could not run contemporary news searches; everything above came from direct URL fetches and Wayback CDX enumeration.
- One process note: the shared scratchpad directory was being written concurrently by another agent and one of my downloaded files was silently overwritten with content from a later season (2015-era coaches). I detected this, re-downloaded every source into an isolated directory, and re-verified all quotes against the clean copies. Nothing in the output above derives from the corrupted file.
